places-central-balkan-severen-dzhendem-r.story: 118 km from Apriltsi to Apriltsi, about 2 h 02 of riding. The stops in between: Central Balkan - Steneto Reserve, Central Balkan - Tsarichina Reserve and back through Central Balkan - Steneto Reserve. The highest point is about 1,050 m. The line favours views over speed.
